lines: Thirty-one years I've kept Mickey's books, love. I know what every fare cost and who never paid it.
Sit down, you're making the place look untidy. Now, what is it you think you want to know?
I saw what I saw. Whether I tell anybody else is a different question, isn't it.
Forty years on the docks and they finished it with a letter. Mickey gave me the door. I don't forget that.
You want to stand there, son, you stand where I can see you. That's all I ask.
Nobody's asked me yet. When they do, I'll tell them the truth, and I'll tell you first.
Alright? Darren. You'll have heard of me. No? You will, give it a week.
Tell you what, I can get you anything, me. Radio, pager, a lift to Grimsby. Mates' rates.
I never saw nothing. Well. I saw a bit. Depends who's asking, doesn't it, and what it's worth.
